references.text: Describes the same geographical area: the mountains, the lowlands, and the coast toward Lebanon as Israel's promised land.
Mentions the same seven nations: the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites whom Israel was to drive out.
God's promise to drive out the Amorites, Hivites, Perizzites, Canaanites, and Jebusites.
Describes the promised land with the same nations and geographical areas.
The kings in the hill country gather against Gibeon after hearing about Joshua's victories, a continuation of the kings' reaction.
Northern kings also gather against Israel, including peoples by the Great Sea toward Lebanon.
Earlier description of the kings' reaction when they heard about Israel's crossing of the Jordan.
Geographical reference to the area on the other side of the Jordan.
